hook_text: From the ground under your feet to footprints on the Moon, one term covered the whole sky. Ready for the tour?
clip_script: Term 4 space tour! Station 1: the Earth, a ball of rock, mostly blue with water. Station 2: the Sun, a star of hot gas, huge but far away. Station 3: eight planets. My Very Easy Method Just Speeds Up Naming. Station 4: the Moon, a ball of rock, phases every twenty-nine and a half days. Station 5: a rocket. Gas out the back, rocket goes up. Planet Earth and Beyond: done!
visual_style: Whiteboard school hall turned into a space exhibition, with five stations: a big globe, a glowing Sun poster, a hanging model of the solar system, a Moon diary wall and a balloon rocket on a string.
mood: Proud and confident, like guiding visitors around your own exhibition.
pacing: Five quick stations, each with its key facts and one common mistake, then the pocket summary.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and draw the eight planets in order and the main phases of the Moon from memory.
